name: Sydney/Kingsford Smith

runway.v: three runways, each 45 m wide; the longest is 3,962 m
runway.quote: 3962 x 45 GROOVED ... 2438 x 45 GROOVED ... 2530 x 45 GROOVED

curfew.v: a curfew from 11 pm to 6 am; only listed quieter aircraft, including approved business jets under 34,000 kg, may operate, taking off to the south and landing to the north over Botany Bay
curfew.quote: A curfew period starts at 11 pm on a day and ends at 6 am on the next day.

slots.v: every flight needs a slot from the airport's slot coordinator
slots.quote: All flights operating into and out of Sydney must obtain an Airport Coordination Limited (ACL) slot

max_aircraft.v: the corporate aviation apron takes aircraft up to 22,000 kg MTOW and 32 m wingspan; larger aircraft must arrange parking with the airport before arrival
max_aircraft.quote: Access to corporate aviation apron restricted to 22,000KG MTOW/32M MAX wing span and BLW. ACFT in excess of this are to contact AD OPR prior to arrival for parking arrangements.

handling.v: ExecuJet runs the FBO and VIP lounge, open 24 hours
handling.quote: Execujet: FBO services and VIP Lounge H24. Civil and MIL ACFT. IS-BAH Stage II.

noise.v: noise abatement procedures and the curfew apply
noise.quote: Noise Abatement Procedures (NAP) and Curfew applies. Refer AIP DAP.

missing: runway designation of the longest runway
notes: The ERSA entry is dated 9 Jul 2026, which was the newest edition found. The 3,962 m runway's designator could not be read reliably from the DAP chart text (ERSA lists 07/25, 16L/34R and 16R/34L, all 45 m wide), so the designator is left out. The ERSA states no distance from the city, no customs hours and no general opening hours. The curfew wording comes from Compilation No. 7 of the Curfew Act (16 Dec 2020); the latest compilation (C2024C00497, 14 Oct 2024) could not be read as text, so recheck section 6 against it. The 80-movement cap comes from the Demand Management Act compilation of 14 Jan 2011; the latest version was not checked. Under the DITRDCA page, the curfew shoulder hours are 11 pm to midnight and 5 am to 6 am, with limits on international passenger arrivals between 5 and 6 am. The curfew is legally enforceable, and dispensations are granted only in exceptional circumstances. Sydney observes daylight saving time (AEDT, UTC+11, in summer; ERSA header says UTC +10); the curfew is set in local time. Extra 'curfew_jets', 'curfew_direction' and 'movement_cap' keys were added under facts.
